title: Mount the app inside an existing Node server
prompt: We are moving an existing node:http service to Inferlo step by step. Create src/legacy.ts exporting `function createLegacyServer(): http.Server` (from node:http, not listening yet). Requests whose path starts with /api must be handled by the Inferlo app from src/app.ts mounted under /api (so GET /api/health reaches the app's GET /health route, and /api/openapi.json serves its OpenAPI document). Every other request is answered by the old service: status 200 with the plain text body "legacy".
